Cisco.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Authorization Bypass Vulnerabilities
Cisco.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities in the web-based management interface of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to modify parts of the configuration on an affected device. These vulnerabilities are due to the lack of server-side validation of Administrator  permissions. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by submitting a crafted HTTP request to an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to modify descriptions of files on specific pages.…
